card.name: Contrast after 'similar to' comparisons
card.fires_on: The linking word (but, although, however, is, has) right after a statement that two things look alike, where a difference comes next. Seen mostly in species descriptions comparing animals or plants.

modes.label: But after similarity
modes.description: A 'but' or 'although' that turns from a similarity to a difference.

modes.description: A verb that begins the contrast, expecting a comparative like larger.

modes.label: Comparative slot
modes.description: A word just before the difference, such as an adjective of degree.
modes.example: The flight call is similar to that of the red-necked phalarope, but generally<< higher>> pitched.

card.writes: It pushes toward comparative words meaning more, larger or stricter, mainly in Chinese.
card.plain: It marks the point where a text says two look-alike things differ, and a 'more or bigger' word is expected.
